text: The Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division is recommending that the future park located at 19 Glen Agar Drive be named "Chimney Swift Park". The future park is located north of Rathburn Road on the east side of Glen Agar Drive and south of the new street, Chimney Swift Court. The recommended name meets the policy criteria in the Council approved 'City of Toronto Property Naming Policy'.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Officially named the future park located at 19 Glen Agar Drive, "Chimney Swift Park".
